shortDescription: Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co. is set to begin trading in Hong Kong on Tuesday after raising HK$7.08 billion ($903 million) in an upsized share sale, according to Bloomberg.The listing will test investor appetite after a flurry of artificial intelligence supply chain offerings in the city.

title: Longsys to Start Hong Kong Trading After $903 Million Share Sale
